name: Remix LokSudhar (लोक सुधार) — Citizen Grievance Redressal Portal
description: LokSudhar (लोक सुधार) — शिकायत आपकी, समाधान प्रशासन का। An independent citizen grievance redressal prototype portal featuring online complaint filing, live tracking, geospatial mapping, and department/field-officer administration.
